environment.description: Same Quarkus function deployed on Knative Serving (v1.12) on GKE Autopilot cluster. Pod spec includes a custom OCI runtime annotation referencing a node-level RuntimeClass 'hardened-serverless' backed by gVisor (runsc) with a supplementary seccomp profile applied via the PodSecurity admission controller. The seccomp profile (located at /etc/seccomp/quarkus-lambda-compat.json) uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for syscalls in the set {execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, accept4}. The profile's defaultAction is SCMP_ACT_ALLOW. Additionally, the Knative revision template specifies securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and drops ALL capabilities. Note: the seccomp profile does NOT filter mmap, mprotect, read, write, or brk — meaning the use-after-free heap corruption itself still occurs, but post-exploitation (shell spawning, reverse shells, data exfiltration via network) is blocked at the kernel level.
